description.value:
This item appears to be a miniature stone replica of an aristocratic home or simple castle.

Activate—Start the Party 10 minutes (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You place the figurine on the ground, and a harmonious note rings out as it grows into a spacious, elegant ballroom. The ballroom is 60 feet long and 45 feet wide, with a ceiling height of 20 feet. Elegant double doors on either end of the ballroom allow entry.

Inside, the ballroom is fully stocked with tables and chairs along both sides. A feasting table in the center of each seating area provides enough food and drink for up to 36 guests, and a cadre of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Phantasmal Minion]{Phantasmal Minions} tend to guests' basic needs.

You can Dismiss the activation, declaring the gala over. As the ballroom reverts to its original form, the illusory dancers clap and cheer for your hospitality. If you don't revert the ballroom on your own, it automatically returns to its original state at the next sunrise.

Activate—Song and Dance 1 (concentrate)

Requirements You're inside the ballroom

Effect You shift the party's entertainment in one of three ways. You can Dismiss any of these effects.

  • Call forth music, which echoes through the ballroom.

  • Alter the dynamics of the music, such as the musical style or tempo, or stop the music entirely.

  • Produce a group of masked, illusory dancers that take to the floor and begin dancing to the current music. When there's no music, the illusory guests chatter among themselves in a nonsense language. An illusory dancer will gladly dance with anyone who asks.
